title: Connectome
card: A brain built from wiring measured cell by cell in real animals. Teach a fish's gaze circuit; watch a larva's whole body react.
tagline: Measured animal wiring, running as a Cadence brain you can teach
kicker: A BRAIN ON REAL ANIMAL WIRING THAT LEARNS
feature: Cadence runs wiring measured cell by cell in real animals as a live brain. A fish's gaze circuit holds a glance in its own activity: teach it to hold, let go and hold again, and its measured connections learn and keep what they learned.
howTo: Larva: press tap left or move light, and its wiring steers it. The fish tab: open Teach this fish, press Teach this lesson, then choose Let it return and teach again, then hold again. The bars show how much gaze it holds.
promise_test: python tools/check_learning_ui.py --hardware --out runs/learning_ui.json && python tools/scenario_larva.py --no-screenshot --receipt runs/scenario_larva.json
